content: Kiara Sen contacted insurance agent Vikram Singh to add her new 55-inch smart TV to her personal-property coverage. Vikram confirmed the addition under a $2,500 electronics sub-limit, which increased her monthly premium by $1,200 after receiving the purchase receipt. Kiara also inquired about the claims process, and Vikram provided a guide detailing that claims can be filed via the portal or chat using an incident report, photos, and the receipt.

action_items: Send purchase receipt for the TV
